description: Build a landing page as separate index.html, styles.css, and app.js with a validated signup form writing into a message element.

criteria: A multi-file landing page: index.html links an external styles.css and a classic app.js (no ES modules, no inline CSS/JS), has a signup form with #email, #submit and an empty #msg, and app.js writes a validation message into #msg on submit. Loads with no JS errors.
